requirement.description: The Nextcloud plugin has multiple failures related to incorrect handling of JSON responses and group/user expansion logic. Specifically, it fails when handling empty JSON responses, when expanding groups/users, and when caching group/user lookups.
requirement.contract: Fix the JSON parsing and error handling in the Nextcloud plugin to correctly process empty JSON responses and handle cases where group/user expansions return empty results. Ensure that group/user caching works correctly and that the plugin properly handles both successful and failed user/group lookups.

requirement.description: The Resend plugin fails in URL validation and instantiation. The plugin is not properly handling URL parsing and validation, particularly around API key and email validation.
requirement.contract: Ensure the Resend plugin properly validates API keys and email addresses during URL parsing and instantiation. Fix the URL validation logic to correctly identify valid and invalid configurations.

requirement.description: The SendGrid plugin has URL parsing issues and incorrect handling of invalid email addresses in the URL. The plugin fails to properly validate email addresses during URL parsing.
requirement.contract: Fix the SendGrid plugin URL parsing to correctly handle email validation and ensure invalid email addresses are properly rejected during instantiation.

requirement.description: The Slack plugin fails in URL validation and instantiation due to incorrect validation of tokens and channel specifications. It also has issues with handling special characters in channel names.
requirement.contract: Correct the Slack plugin URL validation logic to properly accept valid token formats and channel specifications. Fix handling of special characters in channel names.

requirement.description: The CLI persistent storage test fails because the storage mechanism isn't properly handling the storage listing and retrieval. The test expects certain storage entries to be found but they aren't being recognized properly.
requirement.contract: Fix the CLI persistent storage mechanism to correctly recognize and list stored entries. Ensure that storage operations properly track and report stored data.
